name: Guncaster
storyline: You are a wizard who’s been evicted from your tower by your treacherous rival, Spellsniper. In the process, she stole your most prized power: the art of GUNCASTING. Worse still, she’s handed pieces of your magic to her chaotic goon army. Armed with only your backup spellbook and whatever "guns" you can get your hands on, you must climb back up through the depths to reclaim your magic, your tower, and take your revenge.
summary: Blast your way through hordes of minions to take back your tower in a world filled with evil and chaos. Explore charming, ever-changing environments, expand your arsenal of spells, and reclaim your stolen art of GUNCASTING.
